learning_outcomes.text: know techniques and tools for program development
have knowledge in imperative, object-oriented and recursive programming
have knowledge in testing and verification of programs
know the basics of human-computer interaction
be able to follow scientific working methods (identifying, formulating, solving problems, training abstract thinking)
be able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, at least 50% of the points from the weekly exercise assignments must be achieved, and solutions to at least two exercise assignments must be presented orally. Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science program.
